strata.name: bhutan-tibetan
strata.desc: Visible Tibetan books in the bhutan/vajrayana collections (BL EAP manuscripts and prints, read by our own OCR: BDRC Yigdzin + Gemini; no e-text), pages_translated>=8, frame tightened to the lives of Padmasambhava (rnam thar, skyes rabs, bka thang): 8 of 908 eligible books. 69e7481e85f786e884a4b4dc (Lamp Dispelling Darkness) has 595 OCR pages and 0 English, so it cannot be drawn; read separately by eye.

strata.name: derge-kangyur
strata.desc: Derge Kangyur volumes from #5665 (BDRC W4CZ5369 scans + Esukhia PD e-text), all hidden (curation, about to be published), with >=8 translated pages (the 40 84000 Not-Begun texts, 1,835 pages). Drawn from translated pages only; ~2,600 Prajnaparamita pages are deliberately empty.
